arrays.description: sequence of array_like If the first argument is 1-D it is treated as row vector. If the last argument is 1-D it is treated as column vector. The other arguments must be 2-D.

out.description: ndarray, optional Output argument. This must have the exact kind that would be returned if it was not used. In particular, it must have the right type, must be C-contiguous, and its dtype must be the dtype that would be returned for `dot(a, b)`. This is a performance feature. Therefore, if these conditions are not met, an exception is raised, instead of attempting to be flexible.
constraints: Must have right type, C-contiguous, and correct dtype

output.description: ------- ndarray Returns the dot product of the supplied arrays.
